what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Ukraine, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, both sources gave the same figure: 3712000 people living in internal displacement because of conflict.
Others left the country: refugees from Ukraine live mainly in Germany and Poland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
Before that, it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory from 2014 to 2022, with the DPR and LPR among the government's opponents.
Wildfires are the disasters recorded for Ukraine in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure peaked at 5913638 in 2022, the first year of the interstate war, and fell to 3665165 by 2024.
IDMC recorded its highest number of new conflict displacements, a count of movements, in 2022.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
The sources don't say where displaced people are living inside Ukraine.
